services.name: Admission
services.desc: The Haines Sheldon Museum features three exhibit galleries: the Main Gallery displays large history exhibits that change every three years; the Hakkinen Gallery features small art, history and craft exhibits that change every six to eight weeks, and the Children’s Gallery features interactives and immersive experiences for children. Come visit the museum and discover why we came, why we stayed, and why we love our little town. Adults: $10 Children 12 & Under: FREE NARM* Members: FREE Haines Residents: FREE Active Military: FREE The Haines Sheldon Museum is a member of the North American Reciprocal Museum (NARM) program.
